description: §5.2.3 — inline block handlers inside a `<match>` arm run every statement in source order, call-led and assignment-led alike. Click #mc (`{ track("c"); @count = 0 }`): last `c:5`, count 0. Then click #ma (`{ @count = 1; track("a") }`): count 1, last `a:1`. A dropped statement or a reordering changes the final `1 a:1`.
rationale: §5.2.3: "On each dispatch of the event, the statements of an inline block SHALL run in source order, each one exactly once … No statement of the block SHALL be dropped, whatever its kind or position".
